title: Lenny Adapter Binary Protocol (JSONL)
description: Newline-delimited JSON exchanged on stdin/stdout between the adapter sidecar and the agent binary inside a Lenny pod. The adapter receives lines on stdin (inbound) and reads lines from stdout (outbound). Each line is a single JSON object discriminated by `type`. The adapter↔runtime CH-RUNTIMEOPS frames (checkpoint_request, interrupt_request, credentials_rotated, deadline_approaching, and their runtime replies) travel on the intra-pod runtime-ops Unix socket, are schematized in schemas/runtime-ops-events.schema.json, and are out of scope here. The stdin/stdout message schemas are stated by spec/28_communication-channels.md §28.5.3, the CH-MSGSOCK card; the messageEnvelope definition is stated by the MessageEnvelope unified message format heading in spec/15_external-api-surface.md §15.4.

messageEnvelope.title: message
messageEnvelope.description: Inbound content delivery from gateway → adapter → agent. The unified envelope used for client prompts, inter-session messages, and platform-injected control text. See spec/15_external-api-surface.md §15.4.

schemaVersion.description: Gateway-injected at write time. Immutable. Consumers MUST forward-read.

id.description: ULID-like message id (msg_ prefix). Tenant-unique. Duplicate ids reject with 400 DUPLICATE_MESSAGE_ID.

inReplyTo.description: Optional reply-to message id for DAG threading and lenny/request_input routing.

threadId.description: Optional thread label. v1 has an implicit single thread per session.

delivery.description: Interrupt behavior. `immediate` preempts running work; `queued` waits for the agent to drain.

delegationDepth.description: Gateway-injected hop count in the delegation tree. Informational.

sessionId.description: The session this frame is addressed to. The adapter populates it on every session-scoped frame on every pod, whatever the pool's `sessionPolicy.maxConcurrentSessions`. `from.id` separately names the sending session, which may be a different session; delivery follows `sessionId`.

input.description: Message content as a list of MessagePart objects.

from.description: Sender context. Adapter-injects this; runtimes MUST NOT set it.

kind.description: Closed enum. Determines the expected shape of `id`.

id.description: Identifier whose shape depends on kind. client: `client_{opaque}`. agent: `sess_{session_id}`. system: literal `lenny-gateway`. external: `conn_{connector_id}`. When kind is `agent` this names the sending session, which may differ from the `sessionId` the frame is addressed to.

heartbeat.title: heartbeat
heartbeat.description: Inbound liveness ping from adapter. Agent must respond with heartbeat_ack within 10s or the adapter sends SIGTERM. A protocol-level frame: it carries no per-session identifier and is outside the session addressing rule stated by spec/28_communication-channels.md §28.5.3.

heartbeat_ack.title: heartbeat_ack
heartbeat_ack.description: Outbound acknowledgement of an inbound heartbeat. A protocol-level frame: it carries no per-session identifier and is outside the session addressing rule stated by spec/28_communication-channels.md §28.5.3.

shutdown.title: shutdown
shutdown.description: Inbound graceful-shutdown signal. The agent must exit cleanly within deadline_ms or receive SIGTERM.

reason.description: Reason code (for example: drain, runtime_upgrade, session_complete).

deadline_ms.description: Milliseconds the agent has to exit before SIGTERM.

tool_call.title: tool_call
tool_call.description: Outbound request to invoke an adapter-local tool (read_file, write_file, list_dir, delete_file) or a platform MCP tool (lenny/...). When the call requires explicit user approval before execution, the runtime sets `approvalRequired: true`; the adapter then publishes the §7.2 `tool_use_requested` SSE event and blocks the call on a POST /v1/sessions/{id}/tool-use/{tool_call_id}/approve|deny resolution before forwarding the call.

name.description: Tool name. Adapter-local: read_file, write_file, list_dir, delete_file. Platform MCP: lenny/<tool>.

arguments.description: Tool-specific parameters. Validated against the tool's inputSchema.

approvalRequired.description: When true, the adapter records a §7.2 KindToolUse interaction, publishes a `tool_use_requested(tool_call_id, tool, args)` SSE event on the session's event stream, and blocks the tool invocation until the user resolves via POST /v1/sessions/{id}/tool-use/{tool_call_id}/approve|deny. A denial returns the tool a structured `tool_result` carrying `isError: true` and the deny reason; an approval forwards the call. Absent or false means the call executes immediately (no approval gate).

sessionId.description: The session this frame is addressed to. The runtime echoes the identifier it was handed, on every pod. An absent identifier resolves to the receiving stream's own binding on a pod holding at most one slot, and on a pod holding more than one slot it is rejected and relayed to no stream.

tool_result.title: tool_result
tool_result.description: Inbound result for a prior tool_call. The id matches the originating tool_call.id. Results with no matching call are dropped and logged.

content.description: Result content as a list of MessagePart objects.

sessionId.description: The session this frame is addressed to. The adapter populates it on every pod, whatever the pool's `sessionPolicy.maxConcurrentSessions`.

response.title: response
response.description: Outbound task completion with the final output. Either `output` (canonical) or `text` (shorthand for a single text part).

output.description: Complete task output as a list of MessagePart objects.

text.description: Shorthand for text-only responses. The adapter normalizes this to a single text MessagePart in `output`.

error.description: Structured task failure, maps to TaskResult.error.

sessionId.description: The session this frame is addressed to. The runtime echoes the identifier it was handed, on every pod. An absent identifier resolves to the receiving stream's own binding on a pod holding at most one slot, and on a pod holding more than one slot it is rejected and relayed to no stream.

status.title: status
status.description: Outbound optional status update, surfaced to the client as a low-priority signal. A session-scoped frame: it is addressed to the session named by `sessionId` and relayed to that session's stream alone.

state.description: Status label (for example: thinking, analyzing, calling_tool).

sessionId.description: The session this frame is addressed to. The runtime echoes the identifier it was handed, on every pod. An absent identifier resolves to the receiving stream's own binding on a pod holding at most one slot, and on a pod holding more than one slot it is rejected and relayed to no stream.

set_tracing_context.title: set_tracing_context
set_tracing_context.description: Outbound distributed-tracing context propagation. The agent declares its trace identifiers so the gateway can stitch them into the platform trace and forward to delegated children.

context.description: Opaque tracing context. Typical keys: langsmith_run_id, otel_trace_id, otel_span_id, tracestate.

An absent identifier resolves to the receiving stream's own binding on a pod holding at most one slot, and on a pod holding more than one slot it is rejected and relayed to no stream.
